test_ctc_criterion: test the CTC criterion by composing a CTC graph with emissions and computing forward scores
test_asg_criterion: test the ASG criterion by composing emissions with transition graphs and verifying loss and gradients
test_asg_viterbi_path: test the ASG viterbi path by composing emissions with transitions and extracting the best label sequence
create_emissions_graph: create an emissions graph from a vector of emission values with given time steps and alphabet size
create_ctc_graph: create a CTC graph from a target label sequence and a blank symbol index
